baseline: maze-1 assembled source; catalogue from last delta modifying cosmetics.ts and expedition-equipment.ts (Adventure Polish & Shop), current Home Live Character Recovery

production_rules.identity: Existing binturong; cute compact mascot proportions (bear/Naylong reference only for body proportions, not species).
production_rules.proportions: Proposed neutral barefoot design target: ~2.5 heads tall excluding tuft/hat; cranium broad and gently rounded, visible neck, compact torso with short rounded belly, slightly short but articulated limbs; shoulders narrower than head; palms inward toward thighs; recognizable fingers/paw pads below, long tapered prehensile tail, rounded tufted ears, whiskers and short muzzle. Final ratios require comparison to approved visual master.
production_rules.mesh: Editable connected body sculpt with retopology; paws shaped with connected digits, not spheres attached to cylinders. No per-item recolor unless palette or intentional color variant.
production_rules.rig: Single shared bind pose, units, origin at ground, standardized joint names; skin clothing and gloves/boots; rigid sockets for headgear, glasses, backpack and tools; draw/pickup tool mounts. Exact joint positions to be fixed on master before fitting items.
production_rules.qa: Every mesh verified naked/equipped front, side, back, 3/4; skinning tests in motion; no clipping, stretched torso, disconnect or foot float; compare silhouette differences and real runtime item previews. Never mark asset ready from existence or source audit alone.
production_rules.runtime: Keep catalog IDs, slots, prices, receipts, rewards and progression; do not activate asset until validated. Weapons grouped as production type only; original back slot retained. Separate scarf slot or weapon slot is not part of current catalog; no schema changes.
production_rules.format: Editable .blend; .glb delivery proposed, not mandated if another supported format meets rig/appearance contract; FBX optional interchange; icon/preview images independently generated from model, not thumbnail recolor.
